pairs: and we will call upon your name.
et omnes qui habitant in ea:
with all who dwell in it.
nolite extollere in altum cornu vestrum;
Do not exalt your horn on high.
Do not speak iniquity against God.
For it is neither from the east,
quia calix in manu Domini vini meri,
For, in the hand of the Lord, there is a cup of undiluted wine,
Et inclinavit ex hoc in hoc;
And he has tipped it from here to there.
verumtamen fæx ejus non est exinanita:
So, truly, its dregs have not been emptied.
All the sinners of the earth will drink.
But I will announce it in every age.
I will sing to the God of Jacob.
And I will break all the horns of sinners.
And the horns of the just will be exalted.
